note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as PlayStation publishes it (Exophase / PSNProfiles). Guides are this guide's own words, written for this entry, with a cited source beside each one. The game launched 19 November 2026: where no guide has verified a method yet, the guide says so honestly instead of guessing.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned — there is no extra task of its own. Work through the roadmap in this guide and this is the last trophy you get. PowerPyx rates the whole run at about 200 hours and difficulty 4 out of 10, with a single playthrough enough.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. PowerPyx places this mission in Chapter 5, so the story runs to five chapters even though the chapter trophies stop at Chapter 4.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Gold, and the hardest trophy in the set according to PowerPyx. Reach 100% completion — the checklist unlocks after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, and any progress you made during the story already counts. The list is lenient, roughly 60% of true completion: most of it comes from the other trophies, but it demands every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest, plus any 70 of the 80 challenges. Nothing toward 100% is missable; everything can be done in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game. PowerPyx breaks them down as 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps — mix the categories, and the under-the-bridge runs are the quickest. Track progress by region under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. PowerPyx lists them as fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race or race challenge or drone race, and performing a stunt. Check them under Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities. You will do most of these naturally while chasing the other trophies, so do not grind this one early.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. PowerPyx points to its own guide to all 12 range locations and says the gold medals are not too hard. Gold medals are also needed for the 100% checklist, so this comes naturally in the cleanup phase.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations — 42 races exist in total, but you only need one win per location, according to PowerPyx. PowerPyx also lists all 14 locations in its own drone race guide.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. PowerPyx points to 40 unique race locations across Leonida, so any 20 wins count — pick the short ones and repeat nothing. Drone-race wins also feed the race activity type for Master of None.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you about a fishing spot west of Key Lento, according to PowerPyx. Go to the purple map marker and beat him in the fishing challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. There are four Video Games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world, according to PowerPyx. Finish all the levels of any one game once — you do not need to beat every challenge inside it.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's questline — Lucia only. It is marked automatically in Chapter 3: Andy calls Lucia, then texts her home address in Belville, according to PowerPyx. Complete her five quests: Climbing the Cellerichain parts 1 to 3, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. The quests stay available after the story.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's questline. It is marked in Chapter 1, after the mission Island Dreams where you work for Kenton; he later calls and is marked KR in Key Lento, according to PowerPyx. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — find the chests with the metal detector and bring them back. Kenton goes away for a while after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2 to 3, so nothing is missable. Track it under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's questline. It is marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County, according to PowerPyx. Complete his five quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. Still available after the story.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. It pops when you finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1 — just play the story and it comes to you. PowerPyx lists it as automatic after the first main mission.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish Chapter 1; it pops as the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, begins, according to PowerPyx. No side work is needed for it.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish Chapter 2; it pops when the first mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City, starts, according to PowerPyx.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish Chapter 3; it pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life, according to PowerPyx.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish Chapter 4; it pops after the final Chapter 4 mission, Starting From Zero, according to PowerPyx — the same mission that also closes the story.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, gold, unmissable. Finish the final mission — the same mission that closes Chapter 4, Starting From Zero, according to PowerPyx. Once the story is over you keep free-roaming Leonida, so nothing here can be missed.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. It pops during the mission itself, according to PowerPyx.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. Just play the story through Chapter 3.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands. Only certain questlines count — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count as strangers toward this trophy, according to PowerPyx. Strands confirmed to count include Kirk and his Skunk Ape hunt, Kyle at McKittrick Farm, Yago and his street races, and Pilot Pete's delivery chain. You can see how many you have finished in the trophy list itself. All strangers remain available after the story in free-roam.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's questline, Randy's Wish List. It is marked after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner, according to PowerPyx. He wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City — scan cars with WAiNK to check the list, steal them anywhere, and drive them back in good condition for more pay. Still doable after the story. Track the list under Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline — Jason only. It is marked after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers point to Synthetic Labs in Vice City, according to PowerPyx. Destroy enough labs in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter, then Tyrone gives the Spin On This quest to shut the labs down. Available after the story.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations, according to PowerPyx and PushSquare. Meditate with both Jason and Lucia at a spot and it counts twice; track progress under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. POTENTIALLY MISSABLE — the only trophy flagged this way: the first meditation happens at Jason's house in Chapter 1. After the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. It is not confirmed whether that one is required for the trophy, but PowerPyx earned the trophy after doing it, so do it and keep a Chapter 1 save. The last meditation needs both characters playable, which opens after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's questline is marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break — Jason gets a text marking Veteran Hunted in Lummox County, and Lucia cannot receive the message, according to PowerPyx. Bret gives you the Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle and marks hunting spots on the map; bring the animals back to him. Which exact animal pops the trophy is still being confirmed, but finishing his 15 Target Decks — needed for the 100% checklist — gets you there.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Don’t Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets out of 18 in the game, according to PowerPyx and PushSquare. Cards are scattered across Leonida; the 100% checklist wants 15 sets, so this trophy pops early on the way there.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. Hold Up then R1 to scan, according to PowerPyx. Any mix counts: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags — more than 100 exist in total. Track progress under Progress, then Collections, then WAiNK Locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges in the game. You need 70 of them for the 100% checklist, so this trophy pops on the way there, according to PowerPyx. View and track them under Progress, then Challenges, and pick the easiest ones you have left — a lot of them complete naturally while you work on the other trophies.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then escape the heat. This needs both characters free-roaming together, unlocked after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, according to PowerPyx: call your partner with Right plus Triangle, cause chaos until you reach 4 stars, then escape the red heat zone. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia is the easy route, as the police and the helicopter struggle to follow you there. It also pops naturally during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, which triggers 4-star heat at bank vaults.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Only after Coffee Break in Chapter 2: call your partner, then hit 3 robbery targets in a row while the wanted level stays flashing, according to PowerPyx. PowerPyx recommends the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, unlocked after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 — rob a couple of items in each and break the safe in the back room. If it does not pop after the third shop, hit a fourth. The pop is delayed by about 30 seconds after you leave the third shop.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scan them with the WAiNK app — hold Up, look at a vehicle, hold R1 — and you do not need to drive them, according to PowerPyx. Stand on a busy road and scan passing traffic. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning past 100.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 plus R3 while aiming a firearm: it slows time and drains the purple focus bar, according to PowerPyx. Buff focus first with food, drinks or Adrenaline, line up 5 criminals at a gang operation, and use an assault rifle like the Duke 556. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus levels up through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so try again later if it fails early.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA and fly it away, according to PowerPyx. It must be a plane connected to a boarding bridge — the easiest is at terminals E3 and E4: drive through a fence, use the stairs by the boarding bridge to board, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway and take off. Fly at least 1 kilometre away from the airport for the delayed pop. Planes parked on the open airfield do not count.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank — a Rhino — at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, according to PowerPyx. The tanks stand in the south of the base: drive in through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, get in a tank and shoot enemies until it pops.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors and marks jewelry store robberies, according to PowerPyx. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun, find the safe code note in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. PowerPyx recommends Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City. The trophy pops shortly after you leave the store.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is — it introduces vault robberies: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner to carry a second bag, according to PowerPyx. After that, pay Yasmani 10,000 dollars per tip to mark more security vans. Each vault robbery gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and the 100% checklist wants all 8.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It pops automatically in the same Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is, since robbing a bank vault counts as robbing the armored truck, according to PowerPyx. An earlier method: block an armored truck driving near a bank, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it up, then escape the red heat radius.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the whole map, according to PowerPyx. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged area until the map is fully visible.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total, according to PowerPyx: one per gang is enough for the trophy, but the 100% checklist wants all 39. They show as yellow icons when you get near them, and many are marked automatically through the story. Track per-gang progress under Progress, then Gangs.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach and buy an Apple Martini, then drink it standing next to the bar, according to PowerPyx. A small easter-egg trophy — the name nods to the start of the game.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window, according to PowerPyx. You need the Key Cloner first, from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS. Only that blue Banshee counts — a nod to the Banshee in GTA III. The pop is slightly delayed, after you drive further away on the street.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations, according to PowerPyx. You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on a table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway, which you blow open with sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation. The trophy pops after you escape the police. If you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns later, so it is not missable.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time, according to PowerPyx. Available after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, when you can switch between both characters. Work out at fitness clubs — buy a membership and always bring your partner with Right plus Triangle: while one character trains, the other progresses too. Check strength under Touchpad, then Jason and Lucia, then Strength.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile, according to PowerPyx. Click the trophy in the trophy list to see your count out of 500. Turn on criminal-profile notifications under Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile: a demon face appears whenever an action counts. Robberies, stealthy objectives, clean escapes, incapacitations and kills all count, so this fills passively while you chase the other trophies. If it is the last one left, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car — but beware the Irredeemable profile is permanent.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Method not yet verified. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue — possibly robbing it again later in a specific way, in Little Cuba, Vice City. No guide had confirmed the unlock as of 20 November 2026, so this guide will not guess: check the linked PowerPyx page for updates before you chase it.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg, according to PowerPyx. At night after 2AM, go solo to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County: if a blinking car is parked at the roadside, follow the path into the woods to find the UFO, a bright blue light in the sky. Approach it — it drops a woman it abducted — talk to her, offer to help, then go back to her car at the roadside. The spawn is slightly random; if the car is not there, drive away and come back.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Drive any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds, according to PowerPyx. Do it in a crowded area like Vice City or Ocean Beach.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder 250,000 dollars in Marked Bills through your contacts — the fences. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer, according to PowerPyx. Rob banks and Payday Loans, then bring the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total is cumulative across robberies. Bank vaults give up to 205,000 dollars in one robbery, so this comes naturally with the robbery trophies.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend 100,000 dollars across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest, according to PowerPyx — the game has 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops, 67 clothing stores and 11 tattoo studios, among others. It fills passively if you buy gear while playing.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 purchasable garages — there are 4 more story garages that do not count. They cost 160,000 dollars in total, according to PowerPyx. Garages go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver: buy them through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone. Robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3 and 4, are the quick way to fund them.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed after the Chapter 2 mission Moses, according to PowerPyx. Buy garages first — each adds parking spots — then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register. He only takes vehicles without trackers at first; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with Standard Trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
